 158: class GenerationChannel:
 159:     """One direction each; private transport/bootstrap remain platform duties.
 160: 
 161:     master_key is an ephemeral bootstrap secret, never a provider credential or
 162:     command-line argument. It must arrive only through the exact inherited
 163:     private bootstrap pipe. This class does not authenticate its provenance.
 164:     """
 165: 
 166:     def __init__(self, binding, master_key, role):
 167:         _require(type(binding) is GenerationBinding and type(master_key) is bytes and len(master_key) == 32,
 168:                  "private_bootstrap_material")
 169:         _require(role in ("controller", "worker"), "channel_role")
 170:         self.binding = binding
 171:         self._context = binding.encoded()
 172:         self._send_direction = 0 if role == "controller" else 1
 173:         self._receive_direction = 1 - self._send_direction
 174:         self._key = hmac.digest(master_key, b"uoink-generation-v1\x00" + self._context, "sha256")
 175:         self._send_sequence = 0
 176:         self._receive_sequence = 0
 177:         self._revoked = False
 178:         self._lock = RLock()
 179:         self._active = False
 180: 
 181:     @contextmanager
 182:     def _operation(self):
 183:         # Keep the lock through sequence/MAC/result construction. A concurrent
 184:         # revoke waits for an already-entered operation to complete; a passive
 185:         # frame committed first may arrive at its caller after a later revoke.
 186:         # Reentrant encode/decode refuses rather than interleaving sequences.
 187:         with self._lock:
 188:             self._live()
 189:             _require(not self._active, "channel_operation_already_active")
 190:             self._active = True
 191:             try:
 192:                 yield
 193:             finally:
 194:                 self._active = False
 195: 
 196:     def revoke(self):
 197:         # Revocation prevents further use; Python bytes are not securely erased.
 198:         with self._lock:
 199:             self._revoked = True
 200:             self._key = None
 201: 
 202:     def _live(self):
 203:         _require(not self._revoked, "generation_channel_revoked")
 204: 
 205:     def encode(self, operation, payload):
 206:         with self._operation():
 207:             return self._encode(operation, payload)
 208: 
 209:     def _encode(self, operation, payload):
 210:         self._live()
 211:         _require(type(operation) is str and operation in {"challenge", "ready", "begin", "next", "segment", "done", "cancel", "closed", "error", "adopt_readset", "readset_ready", "readset_rejected"},
 212:                  "wire_operation")
 213:         _require(type(payload) is dict, "wire_payload")
 214:         _require(self._send_sequence < min(MAX_SEQUENCE, MAX_FRAMES), "send_sequence_limit")
 215:         envelope = {"op": operation, "payload": payload}
 216:         _outbound_bound(envelope)
 217:         try:
 218:             body = json.dumps(envelope, sort_keys=True,
 219:                               separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False).encode("ascii")
 220:         except (ValueError, TypeError, RecursionError) as exc:
 221:             raise ProtocolRefusal("outbound_payload_not_passive_json") from exc
 222:         _bounded_json(body)
 223:         header = HEADER.pack(MAGIC, self._send_direction, self._send_sequence, len(body))
 224:         mac = hmac.digest(self._key, self._context + header + body, "sha256")
 225:         self._send_sequence += 1
 226:         return header + body + mac
 227: 
 228:     def decode(self, frame):
 229:         with self._operation():
 230:             return self._decode(frame)
 231: 
 232:     def _decode(self, frame):
 233:         self._live()
 234:         try:
 235:             _require(type(frame) is bytes and HEADER.size + 32 < len(frame) <= HEADER.size + MAX_BODY + 32,
 236:                      "wire_frame_bound")
 237:             magic, direction, sequence, length = HEADER.unpack(frame[:HEADER.size])
 238:             _require(magic == MAGIC and direction == self._receive_direction, "wire_direction_or_magic")
 239:             _require(sequence == self._receive_sequence and sequence < min(MAX_SEQUENCE, MAX_FRAMES), "wire_sequence")
 240:             _require(0 < length <= MAX_BODY and len(frame) == HEADER.size + length + 32, "wire_length")
 241:             body, mac = frame[HEADER.size:-32], frame[-32:]
 242:             expected = hmac.digest(self._key, self._context + frame[:-32], "sha256")
 243:             _require(hmac.compare_digest(expected, mac), "wire_authentication")
 244:             decoded = _bounded_json(body)
 245:             _require(set(decoded) == {"op", "payload"} and type(decoded["op"]) is str
 246:                      and type(decoded["payload"]) is dict, "wire_envelope")
 247:             _require(decoded["op"] in {"challenge", "ready", "begin", "next", "segment", "done", "cancel", "closed", "error", "adopt_readset", "readset_ready", "readset_rejected"},
 248:                      "wire_operation")
 249:             self._receive_sequence += 1
 250:             return decoded["op"], decoded["payload"]
 251:         except BaseException:
 252:             self.revoke()
 253:             raise

 257:     """Fixed worker-local owner connection; real worker activation stays closed.
 258: 
 259:     Type identities come from fixed source-bound imports, never an IPC frame.
 260:     The generated input helpers are not real namespace/PCM issuance. Guard
 261:     installation and native quiescence still belong to the admitted bootstrap.

 298:     def accept_challenge(self, frame):
 299:         _require(not self._ready and not self._closed, "bootstrap_single_use")
 300:         try:
 301:             operation, payload = self._channel.decode(frame)
 302:             _require(operation == "challenge" and set(payload) == {"generation", "namespace_sha256"}, "bootstrap_challenge_shape")

 306:             self.registry = self._registry_type(self._permit, self._factory_type)
 307:             self.registry.assert_active()
 308:             response = self._channel.encode("ready", {"generation": self._channel.binding.generation_hex,
 309:                                                       "namespace_sha256": self._channel.binding.namespace_sha256})
 310:             self._ready = True

 316:     @contextmanager
 317:     def _owner_operation(self, phase):
 318:         # This is the only work admission mechanism. No independent factory
 319:         # mutex can allow use/release to overlap a constructor or lazy step.
